source_doc.title: Fabrinet FY2026 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended June 26, 2026)
source_doc.permission_basis: Official public SEC filing; canonical URL retained, research-relevant excerpts stored in library/raw.

sources.locator: Part I Item 1 Business — Customers, Sales and Marketing
sources.quote: During fiscal year 2026, Cisco Systems, Inc., NVIDIA Corporation, Nokia Corporation and Amazon.com, Inc. contributed 19.9%, 16.3%, 10.7% and 10.5%, respectively, of our revenues. During fiscal year 2025, NVIDIA Corporation and Cisco Systems, Inc. contributed 27.6% and 18.2%, respectively, of our revenues.

sources.locator: Part I Item 1 Business — Customers, Sales and Marketing (qualification)
sources.quote: The production of optical devices is characterized by a lengthy qualification process. In particular, the qualification and field testing of the products that we produce for our customers may take three to six months or longer to complete.

We provide advanced optical packaging and precision optical, electro-mechanical and electronic manufacturing services to original equipment manufacturers (“OEMs”) of complex products such as optical communication components, modules and sub-systems, industrial lasers, automotive components, medical devices and sensors. We offer a broad range of advanced optical and electro-mechanical capabilities across the entire manufacturing process, including process design and engineering, supply chain management, manufacturing, complex printed circuit board assembly, advanced packaging, integration, final assembly and testing.

sources.locator: Part I Item 1A Risk Factors — customer concentration
sources.quote: Such customers together accounted for 57.4%, 45.8% and 48.5% of our revenues during the respective periods.

claims.statement: Fabrinet's FY2026 (ended June 26, 2026) revenue concentration: four customers each contributed 10%+ of revenues — Cisco Systems 19.9%, NVIDIA Corporation 16.3%, Nokia 10.7% and Amazon.com 10.5% (10%+ customers together 57.4% of revenues); in FY2025 NVIDIA contributed 27.6% and Cisco 18.2%.
claims.disproof_condition: Correct if subsequent filings restate these percentages; reassess concentration risk if any 10%+ customer share shifts by more than 5pp in the next 10-K.

claims.statement: Fabrinet states that qualification and field testing of the optical products it produces for customers may take three to six months or longer to complete — a structural switching-cost / qualification-cycle disclosure for the optical manufacturing services layer.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if later disclosures or customer-side evidence show qualification cycles materially shorter, or that customers routinely dual-source the same assembly with negligible switching cost.

claims.statement: Fabrinet provides advanced optical packaging and precision optical, electro-mechanical and electronic manufacturing services to OEMs, spanning process design, supply chain management, complex PCBA, advanced packaging, integration, final assembly and testing.
claims.disproof_condition: Correct if the business scope materially changes in subsequent filings (segment exits or divestitures).
